artifact: I-52 CT-21D precondition verifier self-test (round V7, decisions sections 226 and 227)
status: EXECUTION-PREPARATION EVIDENCE; outside the hash registry (AR7-03)
nature: read-only self-test of the tool on SOURCE commits (git objects only). It is not a run against any build under test (section 227: the verifier is not executed against any build in this round). All runs read the V7 files of the round (BA-06 V7 section 2.1, BA-08 V7 section 3.2, BA-09 V7 section 3.2) and the BA-03 V5 specification, passed by argument. The BA-09 source is an extension of the AR7-03 union submitted to the Architect for confirmation (verifier docstring). The BA-03 runner outputs of the --ba03-runner-output controls are scratch files produced by the committed BA-03 runner; they are recorded by SHA-256 and not published.

invocation: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python docs/automation/evidence/I-52-ct21d-precondition-verifier.py <repo root> <build source sha> <output.json> [--bound <sha>] [--ba03 <path>] [--ba06 <path>] [--ba08 <path>] [--ba09 <path>] [--expect-sha256 BA-xx=<hex>]... [--expect-count <n>] [--ba03-runner-output <path>]

selectionRules.BA-03: sources with where = BOUND (path, expected_blob); spec bound_product_sha must equal the bound SHA
selectionRules.BA-06: section 2.1 identity-table rows whose Role starts with "route"; declared excluded: precedent, residual source, quantity source; any other role = parse gap
selectionRules.BA-08: section 3.2 rows with Role W or C; declared excluded: P; any other role = parse gap; path column "under `src/`" prefixed with src/
selectionRules.BA-09: section 3.2 rows with Role W-1 (extension submitted to the Architect); no declared excluded role, so any other role = parse gap; blob or tree ids admitted
selectionRules.blobColumn: the header cell that contains "blob" and the backticked first 8 hex of the bound SHA; the cell must be a full 40-hex id
selectionRules.objectTypes: BA-03, BA-06 and BA-08 admit blob ids only; BA-09 admits blob or tree ids; an object of a type not admitted is DIFFERENT
selectionRules.union: keyed by path; the same path with two cited ids = conflict (fail)
selectionRules.status: per pair and per SHA: EQUAL / DIFFERENT / ABSENT against the cited id; a pair is EQUAL only if EQUAL at both the bound SHA and the build source SHA
selectionRules.expectations: --expect-sha256 BA-xx=<hex> (per input file; mismatch or unreadable file = fail), --expect-count <n> (union count; mismatch = fail), --ba03-runner-output <path> (recorded with SHA-256; its buildSourceSha.resolved must equal the resolved build source SHA; unreadable, null or different = fail)
selectionRules.repoRoot: required positional argument, no default; a directory that is not the top level of a git checkout = usage error (exit 2)
